## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Memo-Setup-x.y.z.exe** | Installer (recommended). Adds Start Menu and optional desktop shortcuts; uninstall from Windows Settings. No admin rights needed. |
| **Memo-Portable-x.y.z.exe** | Single file that runs without installing. Starts a few seconds slower. |

Both use the same data folder (`%APPDATA%\Memo`), so your texts and progress are shared between them and are kept when you update or uninstall.

**First launch:** Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC" because the app is not code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

## What's in Memo

- **Library** with folders, favorites, search, `.txt` import/export, backup & restore
- **9 practice modes** in three steps — *Familiarize* (Read & Listen, First Letters, Hide Words), *Practice* (Fill the Blank, Unscramble, Line Cards), *Test* (Type Initials, Type Words, Recite & Record) — plus **🎯 Weak Spots**, which drills the lines you keep missing
- **Typing tests** with a smooth cursor (line, block, underscore, box), live WPM/accuracy, combos, and adjustable layout (left/center, top/middle, typed text stays visible, flowing text, focus mode)
- **Spaced-repetition review**, streaks, daily goal and reminders
- **XP, levels, daily quests and achievements**, with unlockable themes, cursor colors and sounds
- **14 themes**, accent colors, fonts and **recorded keyboard sounds** (Clicky, Studio, Thocky)

Every release is built and tested on Windows automatically: silent install, launch, typing test, full screen, sound, restart persistence and uninstall.
